fichas.title: Standard-gauge railway structure gauging and clearances
fichas.summary: Illustrates standard clearance profiles for main-line passenger tracks and other tracks, including low-level clearances. The profiles distinguish clearance zones for different track situations and identify corners that must be radiused.
uses: Set structure-gauging and clearance envelopes around standard-gauge tracks
Keep the indicated side spaces free

fichas.title: Additional standard-gauge clearance for curves
fichas.summary: A table specifies necessary increases to standard clearance on the inside and outside of curves with radii below 250 m. The increases differ by curve radius and curve side.

fichas.summary: Shows the upper clearance limit for stretches with overhead conductor wire and gives half-width dimensions by half the curve radius. It also lists minimum clearance heights beneath structures by structure type.
uses: Set clearance envelopes for electrified railways

fichas.title: Narrow-gauge railway clearances
fichas.summary: Shows standard clearance profiles for straight narrow-gauge tracks of 1.00 m and 0.75 m gauge, plus low-level gauging details. Notes European standard dimensions and clearances for doorways, tunnels, buildings, and platform access.
uses: Provide clearance envelopes for narrow-gauge railway tracks
Separate buildings and combustible storage from railway land
Provide passenger access to platforms without crossing tracks
